avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin C (>2000mg daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May increase urinary acidification and potentially alter zanamivir renal clearance; theoretical risk of crystal formation in renal tubules with prolonged high-dose use
avoid_supplements.action: Limit vitamin C supplementation to RDA levels (75-90mg daily); monitor renal function if patient insists on higher doses

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea (concurrent use during treatment)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate immune stimulation effects; theoretical additive antiviral mechanisms could mask symptom resolution assessment
avoid_supplements.action: Recommend avoiding concurrent echinacea during active zanamivir therapy; can resume after treatment completion

caution_supplements.name: Zinc lozenges/high-dose zinc
caution_supplements.mechanism: Zinc may have independent antiviral properties; concurrent use could complicate efficacy assessment and increase gastrointestinal side effects
caution_supplements.action: Counsel patient to separate timing; monitor for nausea and GI upset if combined use occurs

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: No direct interaction, but zanamivir may affect GI flora; probiotics may help maintain gut health during treatment
caution_supplements.action: Generally safe; may be beneficial for GI support during antiviral therapy

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods/salt
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase fluid retention; zanamivir respiratory administration requires adequate hydration for optimal delivery
caution_foods.action: Maintain normal sodium intake; ensure adequate hydration (6-8 glasses water daily) during treatment

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Minimal interaction expected given zanamivir's minimal hepatic metabolism, but general caution with antivirals advised
caution_foods.action: No strict avoidance required; prefer water or other beverages for hydration support

monitoring_notes: Zanamivir undergoes minimal hepatic metabolism and is primarily renascent unchanged; therefore supplement-drug interactions are limited. Monitor renal function (particularly in elderly or renally impaired patients) and respiratory status with inhaled zanamivir administration.
